[*] Gorgeous Starter Pack - perfect 15 Nonogram levels to get you started and tease your brain for more adventure.
[*] Multiple DLC's with different game modes and level styles.

Hey everyone! We're finally live. 
3rd game in our best Sudoku series on Steam is available for download.

Base price $1.99, but you can get it with 50% discount if already have Sudoku Universe (weeklong deal).

[h1]Features[/h1]
Recommended for all Sudoku and puzzles fans. Grab large cup of coffee, get yourself comfortable and go for 50+ hours of mind-teasing experience. 

Killer Sudoku puzzles include all the rules of regular Sudoku but add in dashed-line 'cages' which must sum to given values. Killer Sudoku is also sometimes known as Sumdoku, Mathdoku or Addoku.
[list]
[*] 100 killer Sudoku Killer puzzles
[*] Level's progress save
[*] Beautiful minimalist design, multiple color themes
[*] 10 ambient relaxing soundtracks
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Trading Cards, Badge, Emoticons and Backgrounds (Coming soon)
[*] Cross-platform Steam Cloud saves

notes.title: Your recommendations
notes.content:
Hey guys,
I want to continue updating this game and would love to hear your thoughts and recommendations.

Main "hate" source - achievements. Explanation why i made them:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/724740/discussions/0/1620599015877406561/
Obviously, I can't just remove them now, cause it will bring even more hate. Sorry, but hope for understanding.

Currently, my TODO list for the next update:
1. rework UI ( M S Q C buttons, etc.), so it'll be clear what every button do.
2. ability to turn on/off achievements totally
3. ability to show achievements after game closed (not during a game)
4. divide current levels into chapters + add new levels

Would appreciate your ideas.

Obviously, I can't just remove them now, cause it will bring even more hate. Sorry, but hope for understanding.

Currently, my TODO list for the next update:
1. rework UI ( M S Q C buttons, etc.), so it'll be clear what every button do.
2. ability to turn on/off achievements totally
3. ability to show achievements after game closed (not during a game)
4. divide current levels into chapters + add new levels

Would appreciate your ideas.

notes.title: Minor update - Hotkeys, color theme switch, 32-bit support, bug fixes.
notes.content:
[h1]- Hotkeys[/h1]
[b]C[/b] - switch color theme.
[b]L[/b] - lock/unlock color theme (if you want to play always with one pre-selected theme).
[b]M[/b] - music on/off.
[b]S[/b] - sounds on/off.
[b]Q[/b] - quit from level (if on level screen) / game (if on level selection screen).

[h1]- Windows/Mac/Linux 32-bit support[/h1]

[h1]- Removed Steam overlay opening[/h1]

[h1]- Fixed cursor moving on Linux[/h1]

[h1]- Fixed Linux launch bug[/h1] If still not working, find executable on your hard drive and do "chmod +x lines.x86" and "chmod +x lines.x86_64".

Thank you everybody for support and feedback. 

Best regards,
Nestor Yavorskyy

notes.content:

[h1][b]Community-generated achievements.[/b][/h1]

[spoiler] Requirements: 
[b]1.[/b] Own a game.
[b]2.[/b] Put one(*) word in comments below.
[b]3.[/b] any(**) word, any language.

First 1000 comments will be added as achievements along with new levels on [b]November 24[/b].
Good luck!

(*) - don't spam in comments please, just one comment per user
(**) - word should be meaningful. Can be your nicknames though :)
[/spoiler]

[h1][b]UPDATE:[/b][/h1]
Duplicating comment from another thread: 
I won't add any new achievements in this game, but if you like the idea overall, leave a comment and I might add them in some future games. Thanks.
